features.name: recency_minmax_scaled
features.description: Min-max scaled V1 using the training-fold 0 to 72 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps the recency dimension on the same numeric scale as other geometry features for KNN distance calculations.

features.name: frequency_minmax_scaled
features.description: Min-max scaled V2 using the training-fold 1 to 44 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents event-count magnitude from dominating or vanishing in Euclidean neighbor search.

features.name: volume_log_minmax_scaled
features.description: Log min-max scaled V3 using the training-fold 250 to 11000 range to compress large volume differences.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes high-volume rows comparable without letting extreme values dominate local distances.

features.name: span_minmax_scaled
features.description: Min-max scaled V4 using the training-fold 2 to 98 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places the observation-span dimension on a distance-friendly scale for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: frequency_rate_log_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled event density V2 per V4, normalized by training-fold feasible extrema.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar activity intensity even when their raw counts and spans differ.

features.name: recency_fraction_clipped
features.description: Clipped ratio V1 divided by V4, indicating how large the recency interval is relative to the recorded span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates rows with similar raw V1 values that occur in very different span contexts.

features.name: mean_zspace_distance_scaled
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance to the unsupervised training-fold mean vector over V1, V2, V3, and V4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a radial core-versus-edge coordinate that can improve neighbor ordering in sparse regions.

features.name: recent_high_activity_prototype_distance
features.description: Normalized distance to an unsupervised corner prototype with V1 near its minimum and V2, V3, and V4 near their maxima.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a compact similarity coordinate for high-activity recent-history neighborhoods.

features.name: lapsed_sparse_prototype_distance
features.description: Normalized distance to an unsupervised corner prototype with high V1, low V2 and V3, and high V4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distance cue for sparse long-span profiles that may otherwise be close to unrelated rows.

features.name: recent_frequent_indicator
features.description: Binary flag for rows with V1 no greater than its training-fold mean and V2 at least its training-fold mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a crisp local neighborhood marker that can help separate dense recent-and-frequent regions.

features.name: history_stage_semantic_score
features.description: A 0-to-1 semantic assessment of donation-history stage from sparse or short-span history near 0 to repeated, sustained, recent activity near 1, considering V1, V2, V3, and V4 jointly.
features.expected_model_benefit: Can move rows with similar lifecycle meaning closer even when individual raw coordinates differ.

features.name: geometry_outlier_semantic_score
features.description: A 0-to-1 semantic assessment of atypical row geometry relative to the training-fold numeric ranges and expected measurement relationships among V1, V2, V3, and V4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives KNN an explicit boundary-versus-core cue so unusual profiles do not rely only on raw coordinate distances.
